Zadają oni pytanie: ile jeszcze jednostek motorowych, ile jeszcze wielkich jednostek pływających potrzebują Mazury, by dostrzec, że zabija to ducha mazurskich jezior? co.description: Authored by dsifontes Image Colprensa Sábado, 22 de Agosto de 2026 Lina Tejeiro habló sobre su embarazo y reveló detalles de la cercana relación que mantiene con Greeicy Rendón, quien se ha convertido en una de las personas que más la ha acompañado durante esta nueva etapa de su vida. La actriz estuvo este viernes 21 de agosto en Buen día, Colombia , donde contó cómo recibió la noticia de su embarazo mientras participaba en MasterChef Celebrity . Según relató, descubrir que estaba esperando a su primer hijo cambió inmediatamente sus planes y comenzó a representar un reto físico y emocional. Una de las primeras personas a las que decidió contarle la noticia fue precisamente Greeicy, su gran amiga y quien ya tiene experiencia como mamá. Lina confesó que no suele aceptar consejos de cualquier persona sobre su embarazo. Sin embargo, hizo una excepción con Greeicy, a quien considera una voz importante durante este proceso. La actriz aseguró que la cantante y su familia han estado pendientes de ella y de la llegada de Gael. Incluso contó una tierna situación relacionada con Kai, el hijo de Greicy, quien estaría emocionado por conocer al bebé y ya quiere jugar con él. Puede leer: Prime Video anuncia tres nuevas producciones colombianas que llegarán a la plataforma La cercanía entre las dos familias ha hecho que los seguidores se pregunten si Greeicy tendrá un papel especial en la vida de Gael. Durante la entrevista, los presentadores de Buen día, Colombia aprovecharon para preguntarle a Lina si Greeicy podría convertirse en la madrina de su hijo. La respuesta de la actriz, sin embargo, dejó la duda abierta. Tejeiro prefirió no confirmar si la cantante tendrá oficialmente ese título, aunque sí dejó claro que Greeicy ya ocupa un lugar muy especial. Por ahora, Lina aseguró que Greeicy ya es la “tía” de Gael , pero evitó revelar si también será su madrina. La confesión generó curiosidad entre los seguidores de ambas, especialmente por la estrecha amistad que han construido durante varios años. Lina Tejeiro también aclaró los rumores sobre su amistad con Greeicy Las declaraciones de Lina también ayudaron a despejar las especulaciones que habían surgido semanas atrás sobre un supuesto distanciamiento entre las dos artistas. Al hablar abiertamente del acompañamiento que ha recibido de Greeicy durante su embarazo, Tejeiro dejó claro que ambas continúan siendo cercanas y que su amiga ha estado presente en uno de los momentos más importantes de su vida. Mientras espera el nacimiento de Gael, Lina continúa compartiendo algunos detalles de su embarazo con sus seguidores. Por ahora, queda la incógnita de si Greeicy, además de convertirse en una “tía” cercana para el pequeño, terminará recibiendo oficialmente el título de madrina. in.title: Kareena Kapoor Khan breaks silence on pregnancy rumours after viral video: ‘Pagal kar dete ho tumlog’
in.description: Kareena Kapoor Khan has found herself at the centre of pregnancy rumours after a video of the actress leaving a gym in Mumbai went viral. The clip showed Kareena walking towards her car with her team, with one member briefly using an umbrella to shield her from photographers. Must Read: Kareena Kapoor-Sanjay Leela Bhansali: From Devdas rift to two missed films, are they finally collaborating? Some social media users interpreted her appearance as a possible baby bump, sparking speculation that Kareena and Saif Ali Khan were expecting their third child. लिल्लाह ! . लगता है "तैमूर" का भाई आने वाला है ? . 🤔🤔 pic.twitter.com/Nji1kvkfNM — Er. Rajesh Singh (@Kumar1975Rajesh) August 22, 2026 Kareena is Not Pregnant The rumours are untrue. According to a Hindustan Times report, Kareena is not expecting her third child with Saif. Her team and sister-in-law Saba Pataudi had already dismissed the speculation. Kareena herself now appears to have addressed the chatter with humour. She shared an amusing Instagram Story featuring a man with a visibly bloated stomach, alongside laughing and pizza emojis. She wrote, 'Hat nah be'. Kareena Kapoor Khan Photograph: (Instagram/Kareena Kapoor Khan) ‘Pagal kar dete ho tumlog!’ Bebo also made her first public appearance in Mumbai after the rumours surfaced. Dressed in a yellow shirt and black trousers, the actress was surrounded by photographers as she left a venue. Amid the attention, she was heard jokingly saying, “Pagal kar dete ho tumlog," seemingly reacting to the frenzy surrounding the speculation. Saba Pataudi Had Already Denied the Rumours Saba Pataudi was among the first to shut down the pregnancy claims following the viral video. Taking to social media, Saif's sister wrote, "A bad angle Or a bad hair day! How can everyone assume another extreme!! She walked out of an airport looking slick classy n slim, And today out of a gym! That's it!! I've been convincing my sister to have a 2nd child ... wish that was true! She'll kill me for saying it! Live n let live guys. Some things are left private. No speculation needed. With love n respect." View this post on Instagram Kareena and Saif Recently Holidayed With Their Sons The speculation came soon after Bebo and Saif returned from a family beach holiday with Taimur and Jeh. The getaway was also timed around Saif's 56th birthday on August 16, with the actor sharing glimpses of their vacation. View this post on Instagram Kareena Previously Spoke About Having More Children Kareena has previously indicated that she does not want more children. Saif is already a father of four, with Sara Ali Khan and Ibrahim Ali Khan from his marriage to Amrita Singh, and Taimur and Jeh with Kareena. Also Check: Kareena Kapoor-Dhanush set for first-ever screen pairing in Sanjay Leela Bhansali’s grand mythological jungle adventure? Speaking to Vogue earlier, Kareena said, "Saif has had a child every decade- in his twenties, thirties, forties and now in his fifties. I've told him, in your sixties, that's not happening. I think only a man as broad-minded as Saif could be a father of four children at very different stages. He gives his time to them all. And now, with Jeh, we are trying to balance it out. We've made a pact that when he's shooting for a film, I will try not to work on one at the same time [and vice versa]." With both Saba and Kareena addressing the speculation, the latest pregnancy rumours appear to have been put to rest.

Beatty leads the cast alongside Charlie Hunnam and Rebecca Hall, who portray Borden’s father and stepmother. The series also features appearances from Sarah Paulson as serial killer Aileen Wuornos and Vicky Krieps as Elizabeth Báthory, expanding Murphy's thematic exploration of history's most notorious figures.Max Winkler directs six episodes of the season, with Sarah Adina Smith helming episodes four and six. Co-created and written by Ian Brennan, the series is executive produced by Murphy, Brennan, Winkler, Eric Kovtun, Scott Robertson, Louise Shore, Nissa Diederich, Todd Kubrak, Carl Franklin, and Tanase Popa. The story follows previous iterations of the Monster franchise that focused on Jeffrey Dahmer, the Menendez brothers, and Ed Gein.Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story officially launches with all eight episodes on September 17, 2026, streaming exclusively on Netflix. sg.title: Dave Bautista Officially Cast as Kratos in Amazon's 'God of War' TV Series
sg.description: Summary Dave Bautista has officially been cast in the lead role of Kratos for Amazon Prime Video’s live-action 'God of War' seriesThe casting follows an onset bicep injury sustained by Ryan Hurst requiring surgery and complete reshoots of Kratos' scenesThe project has received a two-season order from Amazon MGM Studios and Sony Pictures Television with Ronald D Moore attached as showrunner Amazon MGM Studios and Sony Pictures Television have officially cast Dave Bautista to star as Kratos in the upcoming God of War TV series. The Guardians of the Galaxy actor takes over the lead role following an onset injury to previous lead Ryan Hurst.Hurst, who was initially cast as Kratos in January 2026, suffered a torn bicep during filming in Vancouver that required surgery and would have delayed restarting production into 2027. Recasting the role allows production to resume in the coming weeks, though all previously completed scenes featuring Hurst will now be reshot. Prime Video has issued a two-season order for the live-action adaptation, with both seasons scheduled to shoot back-to-back.Written and showrun by Ronald D. Moore under his Tall Ship Productions banner, the series adapts the storyline of the Norse pantheon video games. The plot centers on Kratos and his ten-year-old son Atreus, played by Callum Vinson, as they embark on a journey to scatter the ashes of their wife and mother, Faye. The cast also includes Max Parker as Heimdall, Ólafur Darri Ólafsson as Thor, Mandy Patinkin as Odin, Alastair Duncan as Mimir, Ed Skrein as Baldur, and Danny Woodburn alongside Jeff Gulka as Brok and Sindri, with Frederick E.O. ae.title: Ranking the 12 Greatest Blizzard Games of All Time
ae.description: Three Vikings snatched away for display in an alien zoo — that's the premise of a 1993 SNES puzzler you can still boot up today, and it lands more jokes than games with three decades of extra hardware behind them. Which is rather the point with Blizzard: the studio keeps making things players simply won't walk away from. Durability like this is rare among developers. Blizzard's finest titles are still surrounded by enormous fanbases decades on, and the very best of them earned that following the hard way — through gameplay loops nobody can set down. Huge multiplayer worlds, razor-edged competition, genres invented and then reinvented. With this year's BlizzCon reveals coming up, it's tough to dispute how strong this catalog looks going forward. Yet Blizzard's history tends to shape its games, largely because so many of them sit on live service models that keep them permanently in rotation. Rather than sequels, the studio stacks on expansions, DLC and microtransactions — unless a sequel arrives carrying enormous changes. The mid-'90s platformer that invented cover shooting Blackthorne arrived while platformers dominated the first wave of home consoles, and it broke ranks by worrying far less about platforming than about strategic, tightly focused level design that genuinely tested you. It was darker and grittier than anything beside it — a single-player adventure that stood apart on shelves crowded with mascots. Its presentation remained straightforward, arcade-flavoured and simple to pick up. Even so, Blackthorne originated mechanics that would go on to define entirely different genres, ducking behind cover to fire at enemies among them. Gears of War, Mass Effect and no shortage of other action titles are in its debt. The MOBA that refused to be one map This territory belongs to DOTA and League of Legends, and Heroes of the Storm never made a dent in that. It remains a solid entry all the same, stuffed with ideas the two giants never attempted. Several game types and match modes shove MOBA competition in unorthodox directions rather than circling a single core map indefinitely. The roster is the whole pitch: a crossover pulling Blizzard characters from every major franchise, each one behaving the way they do back in their home game. Diablo himself gets to chase down Tracer from Overwatch. Winning demands the sort of teamwork that produces the same compelling collaboration as any MOBA — only pointed somewhere no other Blizzard game bothers to go. Three Vikings, one alien zoo The Lost Vikings shipped in 1993, back when the company still went by Silicon & Synapse. Solving its steadily nastier puzzles means juggling the abilities of Erik the Swift, Baleog the Fierce and Olaf the Stout. These particular Vikings haven't gone missing at sea. Tomator, emperor of an alien empire, has abducted them for exhibition in an intergalactic zoo. Cartoon Vikings trapped in an alien abduction zoo was already a formula for chaos, and then the writing across the story and dialogue lodges the whole thing in your memory. You can still play it through the Blizzard Arcade Collection on Battle.net, and that release bundles the Definitive Edition, which throws in five new levels. The expansion that saved Diablo 3 Diablo 3 launched with systems that alienated longtime fans, among them a heap of microtransactions for in-game items that piled up into real money. Reaper of Souls repaired most of the damage, stripping out what players resented and reviving the game into one of Blizzard's strongest. At the heart of the trouble sat the in-game auction house, where items changed hands for cash. There's no equivalent in Diablo 4, though similar monetary systems across Blizzard series still have a habit of stirring up controversy. Strip that away and what remains is depth. Character builds branch off wildly before ramping into a complex endgame grind that stays enjoyable however many hours you feed it. Replayability came courtesy of the Rift system, which let you and your friends assemble overpowered characters and steamroll dungeons side by side. Meanwhile the rebuilt loot system produced a loop the series had never previously nailed. Why Hearthstone still beats every other franchise card game The card game pivot has tempted plenty of franchises. Hearthstone is the attempt that stuck. It boils competitive TCG formulas down into something a newcomer grasps on sight and a top-tier player can spend years failing to master. Because there are multiple game modes, plenty of decks stay viable — more variety than most online card titles bother with. A steady stream of expansions, updates and format tweaks keeps things fresh, even when the cost is older decks aging out. Its RPG elements lend it a texture nothing else has, so it works on you even if you couldn't name one World of Warcraft character printed on the cards. At launch the Mana system was a genuine innovation, obliging you to put time into a match before your deck's best combos come online. That gives the flashier, weightier cards their moment, and gradually every piece of your deck starts to count. Free-to-play systems mean you can assemble something strong over time. The hero shooter that made every character feel like a character Overwatch was a monumental success, and you could argue it's the finest hero shooter since Team Fortress 2. The explanation is simple: each character both looked and played like an actual person. Reaper with his twin shotguns and permanent gloom. Reinhardt with his shield, hammer and charge. Not one name on that roster read as filler. A steady drip of new characters kept it alive, with team compositions shifting each time another hero slotted into the mix. There was always something on the horizon for players, and the game held its freshness for years. Considered purely as a shooter, its ability design stayed simple. Every hero's kit is easy to learn and, once a team starts coordinating around you, occasionally brutal to master. Its maps are detailed and bursting with personality, while the animated cinematic shorts fleshed out lore that gave the world real weight. Those extra touches accumulated into an identity that stands comfortably beside Blizzard's biggest IPs. Starcraft is still the blueprint The original Starcraft is essential to gaming, full stop. Real time strategy went mainstream through it, carried by Blizzard's signature presentation and its talent for boiling complicated ideas down. Three factions, each with genuine depth, and every unit designed with a distinct purpose in mind. Working out what to build and how to deploy it turns into an addicting loop almost immediately. A large slice of the appeal is the storyline running between the factions. Both this campaign and the sequel's pushed the game's popularity far past its competitive scene. What elevates it to one of the best strategy games ever is how neatly every piece slots together. Considering it shipped in 1998, the strategic complexity that arises out of player skill and expression still holds up. Brood War then improved on it. That first expansion introduced factions and pushed the difficulty higher on an already stellar game, backed by a stronger campaign whose challenges force you to micro your way through every scenario against the enemy. Impeccable level design, and the decisions it forces are genuinely hard. Warcraft 3 gave you hero units and a map editor For its next RTS after Starcraft, Blizzard kept the genre's furniture and added new pieces to it. Warcraft 3 crammed in more factions than the studio had ever assembled for an RTS, and the variety was staggering, with something close to endless strategies open to each group. Hero units complicated the whole picture, loading even more weight onto microplay. Still, it's The Frozen Throne that placed this game on a pedestal for so many Blizzard fans. An already massive game became gargantuan under that expansion, which handed players more avenues into both the gameplay and the story. Add the custom map maker, which turned players loose to build their own RTS maps, and Warcraft 3 ends up endlessly replayable. Diablo 2 built the character sheet everyone copied No shortage of people will tell you Diablo 2 is the series' peak, and the receipts back them up. It carries on the original's dark fantasy ARPG style, then refines, polishes and expands it into systems that would go on to inspire several later smash hits. Deep customization skills and build trees mean you can construct almost any character you can picture. As with every Blizzard game here, its expansion made it better. Lord of Destruction brought an entirely new story Act along with a new area housing tougher enemies and fresh quests. All that character depth sits beautifully alongside the level design and reward systems. Being among the first games with proper co-op, Diablo 2 let you haul friends into dungeons on the hunt for the best loot — as close to a tabletop RPG session as a PC could manage back then. Given the unlimited options attached to every character you roll, the brevity barely registers. The sequel that made esports global A serious case exists for Starcraft 2 as one of the best sequels ever made, taking everything the original achieved and driving it to its full potential. Strategic depth is how it defines itself, serving RTS fans what they want while adding competitive systems that helped esports detonate worldwide. The series' narrative picked up in 2010 with Wings of Liberty. Heart of the Swarm and Legacy of the Void came next, each spotlighting different factions with stories of their own and stacking more content on top. Blizzard supported all of it consistently, alongside a free-to-play model that makes trying it easy for newcomers. The sheer number of quality of life improvements between Starcraft and Starcraft 2 is absurd, and every one of them builds on something fans already liked. Years of tight balance work from Blizzard have given it competitive integrity that other RTS games seldom get to enjoy. Free custom maps, alternative modes, and a genre pinnacle that plenty of people still won't argue about.

ae.title: Dubai Mallathon hits 100,000 participants, clocks 220 million steps in just two months
ae.description: More than 100,000 people have so far taken part in the second edition of Dubai Mallathon, collectively logging over 220 million steps in the first two months since the community sports initiative was launched by His Highness Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Crown Prince of Dubai, Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Defence of the UAE, and Chairman of The Executive Council of Dubai. Dubai Mallathon is continuing to draw strong participation from across the community and expanding to new locations in response to growing demand. Government entities, private sector companies and community organisations have joined families, senior citizens, People of Determination, residents and visitors taking part in the community initiative across the city. Gate Avenue at DIFC joined the initiative on 1 August and will remain a participating venue until it concludes on 15 September, while Ibn Battuta Mall joined on 17 August, opening the initiative to an even wider segment of the community. Dubai International Airport (DXB) is also taking part during August, hosting four key events on Fridays. Participation in Dubai Mallathon is completely free and requires no prior registration. (Supplied image) Sport as a way of life The initiative also welcomed His Excellency Dr. Sultan bin Saif Al Neyadi, Minister of State for Youth Affairs, who joined participants at Dubai Mall, where he was apprised of the activities and took part in a running session. Dr. Al Neyadi commended Dubai Mallathon, stressing that it directly supports the leadership’s vision of making sport a way of life and encouraging people to adopt more active lifestyles, improve their physical and mental wellbeing, and enhance quality of life. He said: “The broad participation of government entities, the private sector, young people and families demonstrates the growing awareness across society of the importance of physical activity and its significant role in advancing quality of life. Initiatives such as this play a key role in strengthening community partnerships, promoting healthy habits and providing young people with a supportive environment to channel their energy, develop their character, and foster a sense of participation and responsibility.” Al Neyadi called on members of the community to take part in Dubai Mallathon and benefit from the vibrant sporting and community experience it provides, adding that the initiative’s true impact lies in instilling positive practices that develop into sustainable daily habits and contribute to building a healthier and more active society. Those wishing to take part can head directly to any participating shopping mall and collect a participant wristband. (Supplied image) Community partnerships Meanwhile, His Excellency Saeed Hareb, Secretary General of the Dubai Sports Council, stressed that the leadership’s continued support for community initiatives provides strong impetus for promoting public health and embedding a culture of physical activity across all segments of society. He said: “The second edition of Dubai Mallathon builds on this vision by transforming shopping malls into accessible, air-conditioned spaces for daily physical activity, giving people of all ages the opportunity to exercise safely and comfortably throughout the summer.” He added: “The strong turnout, with more than 100,000 participants and over 220 million steps recorded, is a testament to Dubai’s success in making sport a way of life that is accessible to all. It also demonstrates the emirate’s ability to introduce innovative initiatives that combine recreation, health, and physical activity to enhance quality of life for citizens, residents and visitors alike.” Hareb further said: “At the Dubai Sports Council, we are committed to supporting distinctive initiatives of this kind that reinforce Dubai’s position as a global model for community sport and motivate people of all ages and backgrounds to take part in sporting activities. Physical activity is fundamental to good health, and making it a consistent part of daily life can have a lasting positive impact on quality of life. This is what we seek to achieve every day through our broad community partnerships.” Dubai Mallathon is continuing to draw strong participation from across the community and expanding to new locations in response to growing demand. (Supplied image) Lifestyle shift Majed Al Joker, Chief Operating Officer of Dubai Airports, said: “Dubai International (DXB) provides an ideal environment for indoor walking, as movement is an integral part of the airport experience. During August, we have transformed indoor airport facilities into walking routes in line with the leadership’s vision of making sport and health a natural part of everyday life. “Hosting this initiative reflects Dubai Airports’ commitment to creating more opportunities for our employees and members of the oneDXB community to engage in physical activity within one of the city’s busiest transport hubs, while contributing to Dubai’s vision of building healthier and more connected communities in line with the Dubai Quality of Life Strategy 2033,” Al Joker said. Dubai Mallathon will continue until 15 September 2026, with activities taking place daily from 6am to 10am at several major shopping destinations: Dubai Mall, Mall of the Emirates, City Centre Mirdif, Dubai Festival City Mall, City Centre Deira, Dubai Hills Mall, Gate Avenue at DIFC and Ibn Battuta Mall. The venues provide dedicated, safe walking and running tracks in fully air-conditioned environments, allowing participants to exercise comfortably throughout the summer months. Packed programme Government entities, private sector companies and community organisations have joined families, senior citizens, People of Determination, residents and visitors taking part in the community initiative across the city. (Supplied image) The second edition features a packed programme of activities, with sporting competitions held at weekends across the participating shopping malls. The competitions offer valuable prizes, creating an energetic atmosphere and ensuring sustained participation across different segments of the community. Exclusive benefits Participation in Dubai Mallathon is completely free and requires no prior registration. Those wishing to take part can head directly to any participating shopping mall and collect a participant wristband, which provides access to exclusive benefits and offers at a number of shops, cafés and restaurants. The benefits are designed to enrich the participant experience and motivate people to continue adopting a healthy and active lifestyle. The initiative supports the objectives of Dubai Social Agenda 33 and the Dubai Quality of Life Strategy 2033, as well as the goals of the Year of Family 2026, by making it easier for families to exercise together in a safe and comfortable environment. It aims to reinforce family cohesion, establish physical activity as a way of life and contribute to improving quality of life across the community. Dubai Mallathon achieved notable success locally and internationally in its first edition, setting a Guinness World Record for the Most Runners in a Mall Run Event, with 1,392 participants taking part at Dubai Hills Mall. The second edition continues to build on that success by attracting more participants and strengthening Dubai Mallathon’s position as one of the emirate’s leading community sports initiatives enhancing quality of life and encouraging a healthy, active lifestyle in Dubai.

iq.title: السليمانية.. جامع "سرچنار الكبير" يحيي المولد النبوي بمأدبة لـ1500 شخص (صور)
iq.description: شفق نيوز- السليمانية انطلقت في محافظة السليمانية، يوم السبت، مراسم الاحتفال بذكرى المولد النبوي الشريف، وسط أجواء دينية واجتماعية شهدتها المساجد وعدد من شوارع المدينة، بمشاركة واسعة من المواطنين. وقال إمام وخطيب جامع سرچنار الكبير في السليمانية، الشيخ برهم سرچناري، لمراسل وكالة شفق نيوز، إن "الجامع، الذي تأسس عام 1959 وواظب على إحياء ذكرى المولد النبوي الشريف، أقام اليوم احتفالية واسعة بحضور أعداد كبيرة من المسلمين من مختلف المكونات والطوائف والقوميات". وأضاف سرچناري أن "المراسم تضمنت إقامة مأدبة عشاء لأكثر من 1500 شخص، بينهم محتاجون وفقراء، إلى جانب فقرات دينية وقصائد شعرية في مدح الرسول واستذكار سيرته وخصاله والقيم الإنسانية التي حملتها رسالته". وأشار إلى أن "المولد النبوي يمثل ذكرى سنوية خالدة لا تقتصر مظاهر إحيائها على السليمانية أو إقليم كوردستان، بل يحتفي بها المسلمون في مختلف أنحاء العالم، لما تحمله من دلالات روحية واجتماعية تدعو إلى المحبة والتراحم والتكافل ونبذ الفرقة". وتابع أن "أهمية إحياء هذه المناسبة تكمن في تحويل معانيها إلى سلوك في حياة الناس، من خلال السير على نهج الرسالة النبوية والتمسك بقيم الرحمة والتسامح ومساعدة المحتاجين، وتعزيز التماسك والتآخي بين أبناء المجتمع على اختلاف قومياتهم ومكوناتهم". وتشهد السليمانية سنوياً مظاهر متعددة للاحتفاء بالمولد النبوي الشريف، تتوزع بين المساجد والأحياء والأسواق، وتشمل مجالس الذكر والمدائح النبوية وإقامة موائد الطعام وتقديم المساعدات، في تقليد اجتماعي وديني توارثته أجيال المدينة.

dz.title: تلمسان: حفريات تابحريت تنتهي مطلع 2040 للوصول الى حقيقة المدينة الاثرية بمسيردة
dz.description: الجهوي : انتهى الموسم الثالث للحفريات الأثرية بموقع "تابحريت" في بلدية مسيردة الفواقة في ولاية تلمسان, وأستكملت عملية الحفريات بعداكتشاف أجزاء هامة من مدينة أثرية ذات طابع ريفي, حسبما أفاد به المشرف على الحفريات الدكتور المختص في علم الاثار عثمان مفتاح. وأوضح الباحث بمعهد الآثار بجامعة الجزائر 2, في تصريح أن الحفريات, التي انطلقت سنة 2023, مكنت من الكشف عن معالم بارزة لهذه المدينة, تتمثل في خزانات مائية دائرية الشكل, ومطامير لتخزين الحبوب, إلى جانب بقايا غرف سكنية ومواقد حجرية, تعكس بدقة نمط الحياة اليومية والمعيشية لسكان الموقع.وأضفت الاكتشافات على الموقع أهمية تاريخية مضاعفةعن المواسم الماضية حيث اكدت الحفريات نواة عمرانية انبثقت من المجتمع المحلي, وهو ما يفتح آفاقا جديدة أمام الباحثين لفهم آليات تنظيم المجال, والعمارة الدفاعية الشعبية, والتنظيمين الاجتماعي والاقتصادي بغرب المغرب الأوسط خلال العصر الوسيط. وأضاف المشرف على الحفريات أن النتائج الأولية لهذه الحفريات ستخضع للدراسة والتحليل في إطار أبحاث أكاديمية, مشيرا إلى أن أشغال التنقيب ستتواصل لأكثر من عشر سنوات, بهدف استكشاف باقي أجزاء هذا الموقع الممتد على مساحة تقارب 40 هكتارا. كما أبرز الدكتور مفتاح أن هذا المشروع الأثري شكل فضاء تدريبيا ميدانيا لفائدة أساتذة وباحثين وطلبة دكتوراه وماستر من مختلف جامعات الوطن, بما يجسد جسرا حقيقيا لتكوين جيل جديد من المختصين في مجال الآثار والتراث. وأشار, من جهة أخرى, إلى أن الحفريات اعتمدت منهجية علمية دقيقة, مدعومة بإجراء تحاليل مخبرية محلية, إلى جانب توظيف تقنيات التصوير الفوتوغرامتري والتصوير الجوي. ويعد موقع "تابحريت" الأثري, الواقع ببلدية مسيردة الفواقة, من أبرز المواقع التاريخية والأثرية على الواجهة الساحلية لولاية تلمسان, إذ من شأن استكشافه أن يسهم في إثراء المعرفة بتاريخ المنطقة خلال العصر الوسيط, وتعزيز جهود حماية الممتلكات الثقافية وتثمينها. واكد سفيان بوزيدي اطار في قطاع الثقافة ومتخصص في الحفريات الاثرية على ان العملية تأتي للتجاوب مع الآفاق المستقبلية لحفرية تابحريت بتلمسان لتجسد رؤية علمية متكاملة تهدف إلى حماية هذا الإرث الحضاري وتثمينه؛ بحيث يعمل الفريق المتكفل بالعملية الاثرية على مواصلة الحملات الموسمية للكشف عن باقي أجزاء الموقع الأثري وتوسيع نطاق التنقيب لفهم تسلسله الحضاري بدقة، إلى جانب إطلاق برامج ميدانية لترميم وصيانة الجدران والمعالم المعمارية المكتشفة لحمايتها من عوامل التدهور. وعلى الصعيد المؤسساتي يسعى الفريق جاهدا لاستكمال الإجراءات اللازمة لتصنيف الموقع ضمن قائمة التراث الوطني، مع التطلع المستقبلي لإدراج ضمن قائمة التراث العالمي، فضلاً عن تعزيز التعاون الدولي من خلال بناء شراكات استراتيجية مع جامعات ومخابر بحث إسبانية تتيح إجراء دراسات مخبرية ومعمقة على اللقى الأثرية المكتشفة وتبادل الخبرات العلمية والتقنية مضيفا أن الموسم الرابع القادمة للحفريات سيكشف المزيد من الخبايا العمرانية.

mg.title: PALAIS DES SPORTS - Raboussa clôt ses 25 ans de scène
mg.description: Raboussa donne rendez-vous au public au Palais des sports de Mahamasina pour « Revy », un spectacle qui réunira plusieurs artistes autour de ses 25 ans de scène. Raboussa entouré des organisateurs lors de la présentation de son spectacle « Revy ». Après avoir lancé la célébration de ses 25 ans de scène au Palais des sports de Mahamasina fin août 2025, Raboussa y reviendra le 30 août, à partir de 15 heures, pour en écrire le dernier chapitre. Organisé par SR Events, avec Ivenco aux commandes du son et des dispositifs techniques, le spectacle bénéficiera également d’effets spéciaux et d’éléments visuels signés Sarysyfeo. Intitulé « Revy », ce rendez-vous sera marqué par la présence de 18,3, Marion et Doubl’E’N, ainsi que d’un invité surprise qui sera dévoilé ultérieurement. « 25 ans de scène, ce n’est pas rien. Il y a eu des hauts et des bas, des moments difficiles, des joies et des personnes qui nous ont beaucoup soutenus », souligne Raboussa. Pour l’artiste, une telle étape ne saurait être célébrée seul. Après avoir partagé le début de ce cycle avec ses proches et ses compagnons de route, il entend le terminer à leurs côtés sur scène. Le choix des invités s’inscrit ainsi dans cette histoire. Doubl’E’N figure parmi les artistes qui ont particulièrement compté dans le parcours de Raboussa. Avec 18,3, il partage également une histoire commune liée aux débuts du rap malgache. « Nous avons marqué ensemble une partie de l’histoire du rap malgache, donc c’est normal qu’ils soient là », explique-t-il. Quant à Marion, même s’il n’est pas rappeur, il est présenté comme « un frère avec qui j’ai toujours avancé et avec qui nous nous sommes toujours soutenus ». Un quatrième invité viendra compléter cette affiche. Une formule musicale revisitée Pour ce spectacle, Raboussa s’appuie sur une formule qu’il développe depuis 2011 : un rap acoustique hybride mêlant rap, DJing et musique entièrement jouée en direct. Il sera accompagné de Volamihanta, Nino au clavier, Herz aux platines, Fy à la batterie, Pa à la guitare, Nanja à la basse et d’un saxophoniste. La programmation fera la part belle aux morceaux qui ont marqué son parcours, mais aussi à des titres régulièrement demandés par le public. « Nous avons ajouté des morceaux que les gens aiment beaucoup et qu’ils nous demandent souvent, même si nous ne les jouons pas toujours », précise l’artiste. Le public retrouvera ainsi plusieurs de ses titres emblématiques, dans une mise en scène accordant une attention particulière à la scénographie. Le rendez-vous devrait durer plus de trois heures. Une ouverture musicale est également prévue avant le spectacle principal, sans constituer un second concert. Raboussa compte 25 ans de présence sur scène, même s’il précise que son parcours sous ce nom artistique remonte à 30 ans. Son histoire discographique débute notamment avec l’album « Rap Mandrakizay », sorti en 2003, avant d’être marquée par plusieurs productions et titres. Par la suite, l’artiste privilégie la sortie de singles, sans publier de nouvel album complet, tout en adaptant certains morceaux aux nouveaux modes de diffusion, notamment sur les réseaux sociaux. Cette longévité ne l’empêche pas de toucher un nouveau public. Après avoir constaté que ses spectateurs avaient progressivement vieilli, Raboussa observe que de jeunes auditeurs s’intéressent également à son univers, notamment depuis la sortie de nouveaux morceaux au début de 2026. Le jour du spectacle sera également marqué par la sortie d’un USB Collector consacré aux 25 ans de scène de Raboussa. Il rassemblera des contenus audio et vidéo, des prestations en direct, des extraits d’albums, des archives, des clips, des documentaires anciens et récents, ainsi que des morceaux anciens et nouveaux. Une manière de retracer en images et en musique un quart de siècle de parcours artistique. Cassie Ramiandrasoa

mg.title: ANTANANARIVO - Des commerçants s’installent autour du lac Anosy
mg.description: Des marchands autour du lac Anosy. Les abords du lac Anosy attirent un nombre croissant de marchands ambulants. Sur les trottoirs qui ceinturent le lac, les marchandises sont désormais étalées à même le sol, parfois jusqu’en face de l’école Saint-Michel. Certains vendeurs ne sont installés que depuis quelques semaines. « Je suis arrivé ici il y a deux semaines. J’ai travaillé comme chauffeur dans une société, mais je me suis retrouvé au chômage à la suite d’un chômage technique. Depuis, je n’ai pas retrouvé de travail, alors que j’ai des bouches à nourrir, des factures et un loyer à payer. Cette vente est la seule solution que j’ai trouvée pour m’en sortir. Et je n’ai pas trouvé d’autre endroit où vendre qu’ici », témoigne, cette semaine, un homme qui propose des articles de bricolage. Hommes et femmes, parfois accompagnés de leurs enfants, y vendent chaussures, linge de maison, vêtements, livres ou encore fruits. Cette multiplication des étals s’accompagne également de problèmes de salubrité. Des déchets sont abandonnés sur le sol et certains occupants utilisent les abords du lac pour faire leurs besoins. « Ils dégradent le paysage du lac », regrettent des riverains. La Commune urbaine d’Antananarivo rappelle que le commerce est interdit autour du lac. « Nous avons prévu d’y mener une opération d’assainissement », indique le directeur du marché auprès de la commune. Les vendeurs disent avoir conscience du caractère irrégulier de leur installation. « Mais on n’a pas d’autre endroit où aller », expliquent-ils. Ils se disent prêts à quitter les lieux « si la commune nous offre un lieu intéressant ». Leur déplacement pourrait toutefois se révéler difficile. Pour ces commerçants, l’enjeu n’est pas seulement de disposer d’un emplacement dans un marché, mais surtout de bénéficier de la visibilité et du passage qu’offre une installation en bordure de route. Miangaly Ralitera

Le nageur du club Managing, Baritiana Mathieu Andriampenomanana, âgé de 19 ans (né le 2 février 2007) et qui mesure 1,83 m pour 68 kg, continue d’étoffer son palmarès. Baritiana vient de signer cinq nouveaux records nationaux, dont deux en individuel (200 m nage libre, 400 m nage libre) et trois en relais 4x50 m nage libre, 4x100 m nage libre et 4x100 m quatre nages lors des championnats de Madagascar sur bassin de 25 m à Mahajanga ce week-end. «Mon objectif à court terme est d’intégrer une bourse, d’améliorer continuellement les records nationaux et de participer au prochain championnat du monde (...) ; à long terme, j’ambitionne de décrocher un titre continental et de participer aux Jeux olympiques, de me hisser dans au moins les demi-finales des Jeux olympiques ou des mondiaux», livre le meilleur nageur du pays aux classements nationaux des saisons 2025 et 2026 sur grand bassin. Organisé Le multiple champion de Madagascar et détenteur de plusieurs records nationaux et meilleures performances était médaillé d’argent au championnat d’Afrique cette année. Il avait raflé cinq médailles d’or et deux d’argent lors des Jeux de l’ACNOA de la zone 7 des U17 en 2024. Il avait arraché la médaille de bronze lors des Jeux des îles de l’océan Indien à domicile en 2023. Baritiana a participé à plusieurs compétitions internationales, dont aux championnats du monde en 2024, aux mondiaux juniors en 2023, aux championnats d’Afrique des juniors en 2023 et en 2025, et au sommet continental en eau libre en 2023. Concernant ses études, le nageur star du club Managing prépare actuellement sa licence en analyse économique et financière. « Il suffit de bien organiser l’emploi du temps. Ce n’est pas compliqué pour moi, car la majorité des cours est à distance », explique le spécialiste en nage libre. «Le volume de mon entraînement est très intense durant la période de travail et de développement où l’aérobie (...) ; durant la période d’affûtage, à la veille d’une compétition à enjeu, je diminue le volume et j’intensifie le travail de rythme de course et j’optimise surtout la récupération», souligne-t-il. Baritiana, comme son frère, a été influencé par son père qui est lui aussi un ancien nageur. Passionné de sport en général, « j’aime visionner des événements d’autres disciplines sportives et je passe souvent mon temps aux jeux vidéo ». Serge Rasanda

mg.title: TIAKALY FOOD FESTIVAL - Un grand voyage culinaire de tous les horizons
mg.description: Les organisateurs présentent le « Grand Voyage Culinaire » du Tiakaly Food Festival 3.0. Et si les saveurs du monde se retrouvaient en un seul endroit ? C’est le pari du Tiakaly Food Festival 3.0, qui se tiendra les 29 et 30 août au Rayim Building, dans l’enceinte de Sodiama à Ankorondrano. Pour cette troisième édition, organisée par Okalou Event et Tiakaly, le festival proposera un véritable voyage culinaire à travers plus de 15 pays. La Chine, les États-Unis, le Japon, la Corée du Sud, le Mexique, l’Italie et plusieurs autres pays seront notamment représentés. Plus de 40 stands seront consacrés à la gastronomie, tandis que le festival comptera plus de 70 stands au total, en incluant les partenaires, les jeux et les autres activités. « Plus de 15 pays seront représentés, c’est pourquoi nous avons choisi le thème “Le Grand Voyage Culinaire”. Le public pourra voyager à travers différentes cultures et saveurs », explique Tsiory, de la page Tiakaly, à l’origine du concept. Cette édition ambitionne également de franchir un nouveau cap en matière de fréquentation. Après avoir accueilli environ 3 000 visiteurs et 34 enseignes lors de la deuxième édition, les organisateurs visent cette année 4 000 visiteurs, avec une offre gastronomique et une programmation élargies. Gastronomie et divertissement Le Tiakaly Food Festival ne se limitera pas aux découvertes culinaires. Animations, jeux, concerts et activités familiales rythmeront les deux journées. Plusieurs artistes, dont Patricia, Monie, Nambinina et Andry Blues, ainsi que de jeunes talents, participeront à la programmation. Andy Rasoanarivo, directeur général d’Okalou Event, explique : « Le concept s’est notamment inspiré du succès des food festivals observés à travers le monde, tout en étant adapté au contexte malgache et à la communauté de Tiakaly. Nous avons réuni le divertissement et l’art culinaire. Ce sera un événement totalement familial ». Cette troisième édition sera également marquée par l’introduction du Passeport gourmand. Les visiteurs seront invités à relever différents défis afin de tenter de gagner plusieurs lots, dont une nuitée au Radisson. La Grande Tablée constituera un autre temps fort du programme. Installés autour d’une grande table, les participants pourront partager un moment convivial et découvrir des plats proposés par différents stands. Une dégustation gratuite de gourmandises provenant de 15 stands sera également proposée, dans le cadre d’une formule exclusive à cette édition. Créé en 2023, le Tiakaly Food Festival est né de la volonté de réunir l’univers de Tiakaly et celui de la gastronomie dans un même espace. Après une première édition organisée sur une journée, l’événement s’est progressivement développé pour s’étendre désormais sur deux jours. Pour cette troisième édition, le festival entend ainsi transformer Ankorondrano en un véritable carrefour des saveurs, des cultures et du divertissement familial, le temps d’un week-end. Cassie Ramiandrasoa

mg.title: VOLONTARIAT - Des jeunes partent en mission à travers le monde
mg.description: Les volontaires réunis pour une photo de famille avant le départ en mission. Dix jeunes Malgaches s’apprêtent à rejoindre la France pour des missions de volontariat de neuf à douze mois. Parmi eux, Henri voit cette mobilité comme une occasion de vivre une expérience à la fois personnelle, humaine et interculturelle. « Je souhaite vivre cette expérience personnelle, humaine et interculturelle et développer mes compétences en tant qu’étudiant dans le domaine du développement durable », explique-t-il. À travers sa mission, Henri souhaite également découvrir de nouvelles pratiques et enrichir ses connaissances. Le volontariat lui offre ainsi la possibilité de mettre ses compétences au service d’une mission, tout en apprenant au contact de nouvelles personnes et dans un nouvel environnement. Les dix volontaires malgaches seront engagés dans plusieurs domaines, notamment l’éducation, l’environnement et le développement durable, l’animation auprès des enfants et des jeunes, ainsi que l’accompagnement des personnes en situation de handicap. Ils seront accueillis dans différentes régions françaises, parmi lesquelles l’Île-de-France, la Bretagne, la Normandie et l’Occitanie. Cette mobilité s’inscrit dans une démarche d’échange entre les deux pays. Des volontaires étrangers ont déjà effectué des missions à Madagascar, contribuant ainsi au partage d’expériences et de compétences entre les jeunes Malgaches et leurs homologues étrangers. Avant leur départ, les volontaires malgaches ont suivi, du 18 au 21 août, une préparation au départ organisée par France Volontaires Madagascar. Cette étape doit leur permettre de mieux appréhender les réalités de leur mission ainsi que les conditions de leur future vie en France. Pour Henri, cette expérience va donc au-delà d’un simple séjour à l’étranger. Elle représente une occasion d’apprendre, de contribuer à une mission et de revenir à Madagascar avec de nouvelles expériences et connaissances à partager. Fanilo Mampianintsoa
